items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: And Buck Banville got that cornet. I seen him at the Waco about a month ago. He said, Johnny, I still got the cornet.

ctx.x: Louis Armstrong. Yeah, I knew he bought one when he went on the boat.
And Buck Banville got that cornet. I seen him at the Waco about a month ago. He said, Johnny, I still got the cornet.
I haven't seen him in a long time. He was playing piano. Yeah. Out at the Plum Plants. You know where it is.
